readme.markdown:
# `@e18e/mcp` > The official e18e MCP server for advising agents on modern and performant best practices > [!WARNING] > This project is in very early stages and may break without notice. Have fun! ## Capabilities - Check install commands for packages that have better-native or better-maintained alternatives - Analyze source files to identify imports that should be replaced with modern alternatives - Provide curated migration guides for transitioning away from outdated packages ## Packages This monorepo contains the following packages: - **[@e18e/mcp](./packages/stdio/)** - The main stdio implementation of the e18e MCP server ## Sponsors

toolsPreview.name: code-checker
toolsPreview.description: Check if the code contains some inefficient or outdated packages imported and suggests alternatives.

toolsPreview.name: lookup-replacement
toolsPreview.description: Check if a package has a more performant, maintained or efficient replacement by package name, replacement text, or topic. Returns a list of suggestions with descriptions and documentation links.

toolsPreview.name: npm-i-checker
toolsPreview.description: Check for outdated or insecure npm packages in an install script like `npm i` or `pnpm add` or `yarn add` or `bun i`.
